# awesome-gamedev-agent-skills

Source: https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache-2.0). Project-local skills installed under `.agents/skills/` from the upstream `main` branch on 30 October 2026. The upstream main ref observed immediately after installation was `19d93f97c9c1ea0f8b306e77aa81e0d3e352d3e9`; the installer did not record the archive commit, so that ref is provenance context rather than a verified content hash. License and notice are copied alongside this record.

The repository guidance covers game development broadly; select skills for the React Native/Expo/Three.js project rather than assuming browser-specific examples or the upstream Three.js version match this app. Project rules, including the no-subagents rule and model-approval gate, take precedence.
